title: Upgrading and Downgrading Your Billing Plan
content:
CloudDash offers flexible billing plans (Free, Starter, Pro, Enterprise) to suit different needs. You can change your plan at any time from the dashboard.

## How to Upgrade Your Plan

Upgrading your plan gives you immediate access to higher limits and new features.

1. Log in to CloudDash.
2. Navigate to **Settings → Billing**.
3. Under **Current Plan**, click **Change Plan**.
4. Select the new plan (e.g., moving from Starter to Pro).
5. Choose your billing cycle (Monthly or Annual).
6. Review the prorated charge and click **Confirm Upgrade**.

**Immediate Effect:** The new features (e.g., Azure/GCP integrations, SSO support) become available instantly.

**Proration Policy:** When upgrading mid-cycle, CloudDash charges the prorated difference for the remaining days of the current billing period immediately.

## How to Downgrade Your Plan

Downgrading reduces your recurring cost but may restrict access to features or historical data.

1. Navigate to **Settings → Billing**.
2. Click **Change Plan**.
3. Select a lower-tier plan.
4. Review the downgrade warnings and click **Confirm Downgrade**.

**Effective Date:** Downgrades take effect at the *end* of your current billing cycle. You retain access to your current plan's features until the cycle ends.

**Credit Policy:** Because downgrades happen at the end of the cycle, no prorated refunds are issued for downgrades. If you switch billing cycles (Annual to Monthly) while downgrading, any remaining prepaid balance is applied as a credit to future invoices.

## Important Downgrade Considerations

Before downgrading, be aware of the following feature limits:
- **Data Retention:** Moving from Pro (90 days) to Starter (30 days) means data older than 30 days will become inaccessible once the downgrade takes effect.
- **Integrations:** Starter only supports AWS. Azure and GCP integrations will be paused.
- **Team Seats:** If you have 10 team members on Pro and downgrade to Starter (limit 5), you must remove 5 members before the downgrade takes effect, or the oldest 5 accounts will be automatically suspended.

## Enterprise Plans

Enterprise plans are custom contracts. You cannot self-serve an upgrade or downgrade to/from an Enterprise plan via the dashboard. Please contact your Customer Success Manager or sales@clouddash.io to discuss Enterprise contract changes.
